title: Money labelled for education
hook: Two stated cases: explore the restriction imposed by an illustrative budget label.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the restriction imposed by an illustrative budget label affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Shortfall, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the restriction imposed by an illustrative budget label in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
